verified Design Truth

Expandable Connection Cards — Optical Power & Peak-time Speed

In the Quality (सेवा स्थिति) drilldown, the “डिटेल देखें” list for Optical Power and Peak-time Speed now shows each connection as its own expandable card. The NetBox ID, status and reading stay on the collapsed row; tapping reveals Connection Name, Mobile No. (masked) and one network id — PPPoE ID or MAC Address. Loads 5 at a time. Also fixes a case-sensitivity bug that made the list render empty.

summarize What changed

  • Fixed Optical / Peak “डिटेल देखें” list rendered empty — the mock lookup was case-sensitive (type=OOR vs oor). resolve() now lowercases the value.
  • Added Each connection is its own separate, expandable card (was one bordered box with divider lines).
  • Added Expand reveals Connection Name, Mobile No. (masked — first 5 capped XXXXX) and PPPoE ID or MAC Address.
  • Changed Loads 5 cards at a time, wired to the debug panel’s Load more (>5) toggle. The first card opens by default.
  • Plumbing phone, username, ppeId, macAddress added through BonusConnectionDto → BonusConnectionRow → the mapper.
